verdict.rationale: Rive is a design/editor platform with runtimes, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path. RML (an XML file representation) and the MCP integration are adjacent capabilities, not a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
